mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/mcp:v0.0.70.overview:
## Playwright MCP Server

The playwright MCP server provides browser automation capabilities using Playwright. The server enables comprehensive browser automation supporting Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit, with full control over page interactions including clicks, typing, navigation, and screenshots. Additional capabilities include network request monitoring, console message capture for debugging, form filling, file uploads, and dialog handling for complete workflow automation.

tool_definitions.description: Perform click on a web page

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

doubleClick.description: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tool_definitions.name: browser_click

tool_definitions.description: Close the page
tool_definitions.name: browser_close

tool_definitions.description: Returns all console messages

all.description: Return all console messages since the beginning of the session, not just since the last navigation. Defaults to false.

filename.description: Filename to save the console messages to. If not provided, messages are returned as text.

level.description: Level of the console messages to return. Each level includes the messages of more severe levels. Defaults to "info".

tool_definitions.name: browser_console_messages

tool_definitions.description: Perform drag and drop between two elements

endElement.description: Human-readable target element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

endRef.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

startElement.description: Human-readable source element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

startRef.description: Exact source element reference from the page snapshot

tool_definitions.name: browser_drag

tool_definitions.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

filename.description: Filename to save the result to. If not provided, result is returned as text.

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tool_definitions.name: browser_evaluate

tool_definitions.description: Upload one or multiple files

paths.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be single file or multiple files. If omitted, file chooser is cancelled.

tool_definitions.name: browser_file_upload

tool_definitions.description: Fill multiple form fields

ref.description: Exact target field reference from the page snapshot

selector.description: CSS or role selector for the field element, when "ref" is not available. Either "selector" or "ref" is required.

value.description: Value to fill in the field. If the field is a checkbox, the value should be `true` or `false`. If the field is a combobox, the value should be the text of the option.

tool_definitions.name: browser_fill_form

tool_definitions.description: Handle a dialog

promptText.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

tool_definitions.name: browser_handle_dialog

tool_definitions.description: Hover over element on page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tool_definitions.name: browser_hover

tool_definitions.description: Navigate to a URL
tool_definitions.name: browser_navigate

tool_definitions.description: Go back to the previous page in the history
tool_definitions.name: browser_navigate_back

tool_definitions.description: Returns all network requests since loading the page

filename.description: Filename to save the network requests to. If not provided, requests are returned as text.

filter.description: Only return requests whose URL matches this regexp (e.g. "/api/.*user").

requestBody.description: Whether to include request body. Defaults to false.

requestHeaders.description: Whether to include request headers. Defaults to false.

static.description: Whether to include successful static resources like images, fonts, scripts, etc. Defaults to false.

tool_definitions.name: browser_network_requests

tool_definitions.description: Press a key on the keyboard

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

tool_definitions.name: browser_press_key

tool_definitions.description: Resize the browser window
tool_definitions.name: browser_resize

tool_definitions.description: Run Playwright code snippet

code.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

filename.description: Load code from the specified file. If both code and filename are provided, code will be ignored.

tool_definitions.name: browser_run_code

tool_definitions.description: Select an option in a dropdown

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

values.description: Array of values to select in the dropdown. This can be a single value or multiple values.

tool_definitions.name: browser_select_option

tool_definitions.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot

depth.description: Limit the depth of the snapshot tree

filename.description: Save snapshot to markdown file instead of returning it in the response.

tool_definitions.name: browser_snapshot

tool_definitions.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.

index.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

tool_definitions.name: browser_tabs

tool_definitions.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot, use browser_snapshot for actions.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to screenshot the element. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If element is provided, ref must be provided too.

filename.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg}` if not specified. Prefer relative file names to stay within the output directory.

fullPage.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If ref is provided, element must be provided too.

type.description: Image format for the screenshot. Default is png.

tool_definitions.name: browser_take_screenshot

tool_definitions.description: Type text into editable element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

slowly.description: Whether to type one character at a time. Useful for triggering key handlers in the page. By default entire text is filled in at once.

submit.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

text.description: Text to type into the element

tool_definitions.name: browser_type

tool_definitions.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass

textGone.description: The text to wait for to disappear

time.description: The time to wait in seconds

tool_definitions.name: browser_wait_for

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of hosts this server is allowed to serve from. Defaults to the host the server is bound to. Pass '*' to disable the host check.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated list of trusted origins to allow the browser to request. Default is to allow all.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: Allow access to files outside of the workspace roots, including unrestricted access to file:// URLs.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_ALLOW_UNRESTRICTED_FILE_ACCESS

environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated list of origins to block the browser from requesting. Evaluated before the allowlist.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_BLOCKED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: Block service workers.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_BLOCK_SERVICE_WORKERS

environmentVariables.description: Browser or chrome channel to use. Possible values: chrome, firefox, webkit, msedge.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_BROWSER

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of additional capabilities to enable. Possible values: vision, pdf, devtools.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CAPS

environmentVariables.description: CDP endpoint to connect to.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CDP_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: CDP headers to send with the connect request. Multiple can be specified.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CDP_HEADER

environmentVariables.description: Timeout in milliseconds for connecting to the CDP endpoint. Defaults to 30000.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CDP_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Language to use for code generation. Possible values: typescript, none. Defaults to typescript.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CODEGEN

environmentVariables.description: Path to the configuration file.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CONFIG

environmentVariables.description: Level of console messages to return: error, warning, info, debug. Each level includes messages of more severe levels.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CONSOLE_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Device to emulate, for example 'iPhone 15'.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_DEVICE

environmentVariables.description: Bound browser endpoint to connect to.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Path to the browser executable.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_EXECUTABLE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Connect to a running browser instance (Edge/Chrome only). Requires the Playwright Extension to be installed.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_EXTENSION

environmentVariables.description: List of permissions to grant to the browser context, for example 'geolocation', 'clipboard-read', 'clipboard-write'.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_GRANT_PERMISSIONS

environmentVariables.description: Run browser in headless mode. Headed by default.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_HEADLESS

environmentVariables.description: Ignore HTTPS errors.

environmentVariables.description: Whether to send image responses to the client. Possible values: allow, omit. Defaults to allow.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_IMAGE_RESPONSES

environmentVariables.description: Path to a TypeScript file to evaluate on the Playwright page object.

environmentVariables.description: Path to a JavaScript file to add as an initialization script. Evaluated on every page before any of the page's scripts. Can be specified multiple times.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_INIT_SCRIPT

environmentVariables.description: Keep the browser profile in memory; do not save it to disk.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_ISOLATED

environmentVariables.description: Disable the sandbox for all process types that are normally sandboxed.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_NO_SANDBOX

environmentVariables.description: Path to the directory for output files.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Whether to save snapshots, console messages, and network logs to a file or to standard output. Possible values: file, stdout. Defaults to stdout.

environmentVariables.description: Port to listen on for SSE transport.

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domains to bypass the proxy, for example '.com,chromium.org,.domain.com'.

environmentVariables.description: Proxy server, for example 'http://myproxy:3128' or 'socks5://myproxy:8080'.

environmentVariables.description: Whether to save the Playwright MCP session into the output directory.

environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_USER_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Browser viewport size in pixels, for example '1280x720'.
environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_VIEWPORT_SIZE
